name: Revocation Completeness and Purchase Ceiling
goal: Revoke every issued TicketIssue for an Order of any historical size and enforce an absolute platform ceiling on new customer purchases.
dependencies: VS-15A Core Revocation and Scanner Visibility
VS-15B Admin Refund and Revocation Operations

revocation.pagination: bounded ascending-id keyset pages scoped by sales_order_id and issued status
revocation.order_lock: same pg_advisory_xact_lock(order_id) call and namespace as FastCheck.Tickets.Issuer
revocation.transaction: one outer Postgres transaction with per-ticket savepoints
revocation.completion_authority: authoritative count of issued TicketIssues must equal zero
revocation.mobile_sync: one complete changed-attendee aggregation inside the transaction; failure rolls back all pages
revocation.cache_invalidation: one post-commit invalidation for every successfully revoked attendee

purchase_limits.checkout_enforcement: before inventory reservation and durable commercial writes
purchase_limits.offer_action_validation: create and update at TicketOffer resource actions plus OfferManagement
purchase_limits.event_whatsapp_cap: positive values up to the platform maximum; existing default remains 9
purchase_limits.whatsapp_effective_cap: minimum of platform, current Offer, and current Event limits
